22 October 2026: the shared engine was made its own part (parts/resident). Labels and comments were moved from the existing maps by script, with the opening's wording kept where scenes differed (parts/resident/merge-notes.md); no comment was written. Snapshots were rebuilt from the supplied disks and compared byte for byte (parts/resident/facts.md). No independent sample or audit.

Drawn across all 23 parts. Four of the eight were one pattern: text comments saying nothing names them, when a handler word at $8BC0-$8C3F (the text address less $8000) does; 321 such comments in 19 scenes were corrected with them. Over the mark: a full audit is needed before Silver.

and every claim in facts.md (the game's and all nine parts' files): 12 corrected, 63 live-observation claims unverifiable from the bytes. Commonest errors: incomplete caller and reader lists, texts said to be named by nothing when a handler word or pointer table names them, and branch conditions reversed.
